describes: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812), 2026-10-09
pinRule: every reference pin is one exact version of one named package with its registry and integrity; ranges, dist-tags, prereleases, canary, nightly and legacy lines never appear as a pin
admissionRule: FWA1 reads the resolved installed version of a profile's release package. A resolved version inside the profile's admittedLine is admitted as its own exact release (VID0 R04, R09); anything else is unsupported-version and is never coerced (VID0 R06). The referencePin is the exact release whose official tables populate the vocabulary; an admitted release other than the reference pin uses the reference tables, and a name outside them is Unavailable, never an error (LIQ4-AC2).

release.role: Liquid engine of the Shopify platform; tag and filter tables of the engine core

pinnedData.role: Shopify's official theme reference data bundled in the published tarball: data/tags.json, data/filters.json, data/objects.json (catalogs) and the theme JSON schemas listed by data/manifest_theme.json
Shopify's official theme grammar; its RAW_TAGS list is the source of the `schema` tag, which the docs catalog does not list

profiles.notes: A Shopify theme vendors no engine, so a theme-root activation carries no resolved version: it admits exactly this profile's reference release with provenance theme-root (activation policy AP-S1).

release.role: Jekyll's tags, filters and site payload

engine.notes: The engine is a dependency of the admitted Jekyll release, not an admitted `liquid` line of its own. It is why the jekyll dialect has no `render`, `echo`, `liquid`, `doc` or inline `#` tag.

release.role: LiquidJS default engine: the tags and filters registered on a default `new Liquid()`
Eleventy's default filters, data-cascade objects and Liquid engine options

engine.notes: Equal to the liquidjs profile's reference pin; a diverged engine pin between the two profiles is a lock failure (LIQ0-AC1 twin `diverged-engine-pin`). Eleventy constructs the engine with strictFilters: true and extname .liquid (src/Engines/Liquid.js).

defaultPlugins.notes: Source of the eleventy getBundle and getBundleFileUrl tags (liquid-vocabulary.json). 3.0.7 is the only published release the dependency range admits.

nextLines.reason: prerelease only; no stable 11 release is announced. It becomes a second profile only through a ratified amendment of this lock (charter: a prerelease next line becomes a second profile only once ratified here).
canary line; canary is never admitted (framework-common Versions). It becomes a second profile only through a ratified amendment of this lock.

excludedLines.reason: legacy major for the shopify profile; admitted only as the engine dependency of the jekyll release
legacy line; the charter admits Jekyll 4.4.x only
